crossRefs.note: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill…
For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man…
At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne…
When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn…
and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch…
The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of…
Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the…
The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.
translations.bsb: and every firstborn son in the land of Egypt will die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, to the firstborn of the servant girl behind the hand mill, as well as the firstborn of all the cattle.
translations.kjv: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
translations.asv: and all the first-born in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first-born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the first-born of the maid-servant that is behind the mill; and all the first-born of cattle.
